yugen-merchant.settings.buy-multiplier.h: The default multiplier applied to items players buy from merchants.
The default multiplier applied to items players sell to merchants.
yugen-merchant.settings.item-types.name: Allowed Item Types
yugen-merchant.settings.item-types.hint: A comma-separated list of item types that can be sold to merchants (e.g., weapon, armor, equipment, consumable). Leave empty to allow all.
yugen-merchant.settings.disable-when-dea: If enabled, the shop icon will not appear for tokens that are defeated or have 0 HP.
yugen-merchant.settings.allow-zero-value: If enabled, items with a calculated value of 0 will still appear in the sell list.
yugen-merchant.settings.randomize-quanti: If enabled, dragging new items into the virtual inventory will assign a random quantity (1-10).
yugen-merchant.settings.debug-mode.name: Debug Mode
yugen-merchant.settings.debug-mode.hint: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting pricing and inventory issues.
yugen-merchant.notifications.too-far: You are too far away from the merchant to trade (Limit: {range}ft).
yugen-merchant.config.merchant-status.hi: When enabled, this token acts as a virtual merchant. Stock the shop by dragging items into the inventory box below.
yugen-merchant.config.merchant-status.in: When enabled, the merchant has unlimited gold and ignores its character sheet balance.
yugen-merchant.config.merchant-status.gr: Whispered to players when they open the shop. Leave empty to disable.
yugen-merchant.config.merchant-status.ow: When enabled, players who own this token can access the Manage tab.
Define services linked to macros that players can purchase.
yugen-merchant.config.merchant-discounts: Players pay this percentage of the item value (Default: 100%).
Merchant pays this percentage when buying from players (Default: 50%).
No items in stock. Drag and drop items here to stock the shop.
yugen-merchant.config.rarity-multipliers: Multipliers applied based on item rarity. Values are percentage of base price.
